lines.text: Samuel, the cooling hold before letdown on AF-12 costs us about 30 min per
batch. Is it still required now that all hoses are antistatic?
Reply from S. Adeyemi: Yes. As long as we let down with white spirit
(flash point about 39 °C) the batch must be below 40 °C. Antistatic hoses
reduce ignition sources; they do not remove the vapour. See IR-2001-007.
